prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter-length demi statue portrait, 9-band horizontal multi-material body, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in onee-gyaru makeup — smooth healthy skin, defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips, long sleek chestnut waves, a poised, mature, confident expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big gold hoop with a small pearl drop.

Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — shoulders more than four times a normal woman's width, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, no waist at all, hips as broad as the shoulders, left arm crystal, right arm stone, torso/hip/thigh-stubs in 9 stepped horizontal bands.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent deep cobalt-blue cast glass, never hollow. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid white Carrara marble veined with soft grey streaks, completely opaque, completely opaque.

Torso, hips and both thigh-stubs (excluding arms): 9 equal horizontal bands, stacked top to bottom, each with a raised stepped edge and shadow at its border, no gaps, no skin. Band 1 (torso/hip band 1): solid transparent deep ruby-red cast glass. Band 2 (torso/hip band 2): solid transparent clear sea-blue aquamarine crystal. Band 3 (torso/hip band 3): solid transparent deep cobalt-blue cast glass. Band 4 (torso/hip band 4): solid transparent amethyst crystal. Band 5 (torso/hip band 5): solid transparent soft pink rose quartz. Band 6 (torso/hip band 6): solid transparent milky moonstone. Band 7 (torso/hip band 7): solid transparent milky precious opal. Band 8 (torso/hip band 8): solid transparent orange-red carnelian. Band 9 (both thigh-stubs, right at the knee, where the leg would bend): carved solid vivid sky-blue turquoise with dark matrix veining, completely opaque, rounding off at both tips.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep sapphire on one side and a warm peach on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so sapphire light glances off one side and peach light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
